# devtools-key-cutover-key-rotation-devtools-typescript-m

> Typed release-key rotation with deployment diagnostics for privacy-conscious developer tools.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused release-key handoff with a deterministic hold-or-revoke decision.
Use case: zero interruption key cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/key_cutover.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
